flags.why: Tị means to feel jealous or resentful of another person's advantages, rather than to compare or liken ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-t%E1%BB%8B)).
flags.fix: to be jealous; to resent someone getting more than oneself

flags.why: Đậy does not mean to replace someone; its uncommon related use means paying on someone else's behalf ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-%C4%91%E1%BA%ADy)).
